name: Path of the Berserker

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Rage turned into pure violence: Frenzy adds damage to reckless blows, and later fear and charm can't take hold.

feature.name: Frenzy
feature.summary: While raging, the first Strength hit each turn after Reckless Attack deals extra d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.
feature.text: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, the first target you hit on that turn with an attack that uses Strength takes extra damage of the attack's type: roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus and add them.

feature.name: Mindless Rage
feature.summary: While raging you are immune to Charmed and Frightened; entering a Rage ends them.
feature.text: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you are Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, that condition ends on you.

feature.name: Retaliation
feature.summary: Reaction: when a creature within 5 feet damages you, make one melee attack against it.

feature.name: Intimidating Presence
feature.summary: Bonus Action: creatures you choose in a 30-foot emanation make a Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute; once per Long Rest or spend a Rage use.
